framing.modelLevel: Set 1: 41/87, 0 unsafe; set 2: 70/131, 0 unsafe; set 3: 46/94, 1 unsafe (prior_therapy_excluded, NCT06170788, U16).
framing.priorTherapyAlwaysDiscussReason: The shipped cache omits parser prior_therapy_* classes from typedChecks, so those items stay in Discuss. A separate client rule, src/match/population.ts tkiNaiveConflict, still marks a trial Unlikely when the title says TKI-naive, treatment-naive, previously untreated, or no prior treatment/therapy, and the chart lists a targeted TKI. That title-based rule is an automated prior-therapy gate. It is not a parser typed check, so it is not scored in this file's model-level or user-visible typed-check counts.

trials.note: KEYMAKER-U01A for treatment-naive stage IV NSCLC. Both personas have a prior TKI (osimertinib or alectinib). Correct exclusion.
Previously untreated KRAS G12C NSCLC. Both personas had prior TKI and do not have KRAS G12C. Correct exclusion; would be Unlikely anyway.
Neladalkib for TKI-naive ALK-positive NSCLC versus first-line alectinib. Alex is not ALK-positive. Sam is ALK-positive but already progressed on alectinib. Correct exclusion.
No prior treatment for advanced disease and no actionable genomic alterations. Both personas have prior TKI and an actionable driver. Correct exclusion. Also in held-out set 1.
Previously untreated KRAS G12C NSCLC. Correct exclusion; would be Unlikely anyway.
KRYSTAL-4, previously untreated KRAS G12C NSCLC. Correct exclusion; would be Unlikely anyway.
ROSETTA Lung-202, previously untreated / first-line advanced NSCLC with PD-L1 >= 50%. Both personas have a prior TKI. Correct exclusion.

tkiNaiveConflictAudit.action: No code change. The rule stayed an automated title-based prior-therapy gate. None of the 7 trials was an unsafe exclusion when scored against the trial title and each persona's prior TKI.
